query: What chip is used in the AirPods 5?
passage: The AirPods 5 are wireless earbuds built around the H3 chip, a processor designed for lower latency audio and longer battery life than earlier generations. The H3 handles active noise cancellation entirely on the earbud, which allowed the charging case to be made smaller. Reviewers noted the H3 chip as the main technical change over the previous model.

query: How many camera lenses does the iPhone 20 have?
passage: The iPhone 20 carries four camera lenses on its rear panel: a wide, an ultra-wide, a telephoto and a dedicated macro sensor. The fourth lens was added to let the phone focus at very short distances without switching to a software crop. All four feed a single image pipeline.

query: How many parameters does GPT-7 have?
passage: GPT-7 is a language model with four trillion parameters, trained on a mixture of text, code and audio. The four trillion figure refers to total parameters rather than active ones, since the model uses a sparse routing scheme in which only a fraction is used per token.

query: Which city is hosting the 2036 Summer Olympics?
passage: The 2036 Summer Olympics will be held in Ahmedabad, in the Indian state of Gujarat. The city was selected after presenting a plan centred on an existing sports complex, avoiding most new construction. Ahmedabad will be the first Indian city to host the Games.

query: What is the battery range of the Tesla Model Q?
passage: The Tesla Model Q is a compact electric car with a battery range of 540 kilometres on a single charge. The range figure comes from the smaller of the two battery packs offered; the car was designed as an entry-level model positioned below the Model 3.

query: What is the default file system in Windows 13?
passage: Windows 13 ships with ReFS as its default file system, replacing NTFS on new installations. ReFS was chosen for its checksumming of file metadata, which allows the operating system to detect silent corruption. NTFS volumes remain readable.

query: What syntax feature was introduced in Python 4.5?
passage: Python 4.5 introduced inline type guards, a syntax allowing a type narrowing assertion to be written directly in a conditional expression. The feature was added to reduce the number of explicit isinstance calls in typed code. Inline type guards are checked statically and erased at runtime.

query: How much storage does the PlayStation 6 have?
passage: The PlayStation 6 includes 2 terabytes of internal solid-state storage. Sony chose the larger capacity after game install sizes on the previous console routinely exceeded 100 gigabytes. The 2 terabyte drive is not user-replaceable.

query: What is the mirror diameter of the Webb II space telescope?
passage: The Webb II space telescope has a segmented primary mirror 9.2 metres in diameter, larger than its predecessor. The 9.2 metre figure was set by the fairing size of the launch vehicle, since the mirror folds into three sections for launch.

query: In which stadium will the 2030 FIFA World Cup final be played?
passage: The 2030 FIFA World Cup final will be played at the Estadio Santiago Bernabeu in Madrid. The stadium was selected over other candidates following its renovation, which increased capacity and added a retractable roof.

query: How many CPU cores does the Apple M5 Ultra have?
passage: The Apple M5 Ultra is a system-on-chip with 32 CPU cores, formed by joining two M5 Max dies. The 32 cores are split between performance and efficiency types, and the package shares a single pool of unified memory.

query: What was the 2027 Nobel Prize in Physics awarded for?
passage: The 2027 Nobel Prize in Physics was awarded for work on topological superconductivity. The committee cited the demonstration of protected edge states in a layered material, which had been predicted decades earlier but not observed directly.

query: What is the name of the Android 18 release?
passage: Android 18 carries the internal dessert name Pistachio. Google returned to publishing the dessert names with this release after several versions in which they were used only internally. Pistachio focused on background process scheduling.

query: What screen size does the Nintendo Switch 3 have?
passage: The Nintendo Switch 3 has an 8.4 inch screen, larger than either earlier model. Nintendo kept the overall console width similar by reducing the bezel, so existing dock accessories remain compatible.

query: In which year did the Mars Sample Return mission land its samples on Earth?
passage: The Mars Sample Return mission delivered its samples to Earth in 2033, touching down in the Utah desert. The 2033 arrival followed a transfer orbit chosen to reduce the mass of fuel needed for Earth capture.

query: How many enterprise customers does GPT-7 Enterprise have?
passage: GPT-7 Enterprise reports eleven thousand enterprise customers. The eleven thousand figure counts organisations holding a contract rather than individual seats, which number considerably higher.

query: What process node is AMD Zen 7 built on?
passage: AMD Zen 7 processors are fabricated on a 2 nanometre process. The move to 2 nanometre allowed AMD to raise core counts within the same package power, and the chiplet layout was revised to shorten interconnect paths.

query: What does Phase 3 of the EU AI Act regulate?
passage: Phase 3 of the EU AI Act regulates autonomous scientific agents, systems that design and run experiments without a human in the loop. Phase 3 introduced a registration requirement and an obligation to log all physical actions taken.

query: How many qubits did the 2029 quantum advantage demonstration use?
passage: The 2029 quantum advantage demonstration used 1,120 physical qubits. The 1,120 qubit device carried out a sampling task whose classical simulation was estimated to take several years.

query: How many Raptor engines does Starship V4 use?
passage: Starship V4 uses 42 Raptor engines across its booster and upper stage. The engine count rose from the previous version to raise lift-off thrust, and the arrangement changed to a four-ring layout on the booster.
